heuristics.statement: For the doubling iteration G of proof.md Section 3 (Pollard rho on order-6 automorphism equivalence classes, each step doubling the representative before adding the table entry), the classes visited by a trail behave like the iterates of a uniform random mapping on the N'' = 1 + (r-1)/6 classes for (i) collision (birthday) statistics and (ii) per-step uniformity used in the cycle-density bounds, including conditioning on the phase pattern in the nonzero-coefficient case of proof.md Section 6.4. No short-cycle statistics are assumed: automatic cycles of every length 1 <= ell <= 2^30 are excluded exactly (proof.md Sections 6.2-6.3, via ord_r(2) = (r-1)/2^6), and the residual coincidence-cycle content is bounded by the counting of Section 6.4 and measured exactly at toy scale by functional-graph census.
heuristics.support: The v2 form of this heuristic failed because the plain walk's two-cycle content is systematic, and the v3 form failed because the bumped walk admits an automatic two-cycle family its lemma missed; v4 changes the step's linear coefficient from mu to 2*mu so that no automatic cycle exists at any relevant length, proved from the exact order of 2 modulo r (factorisation of r-1 and seven modular exponentiations, all printed in proof.md Section 6.2). Empirically: the included experiment's doubling-walk attack run matches the birthday model in the total-steps metric (success 0.600 against the 0.405 budget target, mean visited 447.7 against the predicted 453.3, trapped trails 4 against the plain control's 485), and its census mode finds the plain walk's two-cycle states tracking N''/(6J) (1430/620/352/192 at J=16/32/64/128 against 1363/681/341/170) while the doubling walk's are 0/2/0/2, with total cyclic states at the random-mapping scale (proof.md Section 8).

limitations: Analytic construction; no full-size execution or independent qualification.

Success probability 0.405 is conditional on the disclosed random-mapping heuristic H1 as scoped in claim.json and proof.md; the exclusion of automatic cycles, collision algebra, exceptional-step enforcement and scalar schedule are exact.
The declared exponential memory (2^113 bytes) is required; this is not a practical break of secp256k1.
Per-step instruction bounds are analytical upper bounds in the cost model's scalar AArch64 instruction basis, not measurements of an implementation.
